about: Row ids behind newmean-pii's external evaluation samples (2026-10-28 sampling, manifest written 2026-10-29). Rebuild with scripts/ext_data.py eval; the raw datasets are not redistributed.

openpii_val.selection: 200 random rows per language (reservoir sampling, seed 20261028)

kdpii_test.split: no official split; document-level 85/15 (documents shuffled with seed 20261028), the 15% side
kdpii_test.selection: every sentence of the test documents

nemotron_test.selection: 1,000 random rows per locale (us, intl), seed 20261028
nemotron_test.id_format: <locale>:<uid> (uid repeats across the us and intl locales)

gretel_fin_test.selection: up to 400 random rows per language, 7 languages, seed 20261028
